title: Data
text: using dataset sourced Con Edison’s Outage Management System (OMS). context, Con Edison utility based New York City. provides electricity, gas, steam NYC Westchester County. OMS team analyzes reports power outage non-outage events across 5 boroughs Westchester. event-level columns ’re using : Event ID - unique identifier per record Total Customers Affected - number customers power particular event Start Date - date time event began Restoration Date - date time power restored particular event Completed Date - date time event completed. event non-outage, restoration completed date . Momentary Event Flag - displays 1 event momentary event, 0 event . Momentaries events restored within 15 min start date. Device Type - type device affected event. Devices structures provide power customers. One device can supply power multiple residencies. Device Outage Flag - displays 1 device , 0 device event . Outage Flag - displays 1 event customers power, 0 customers affected. XBoro - name Borough event located Udf Municipality - NYC, name borough event located. Westchester, name specific muni event located. Trouble Code - short code describing clues event. legend mapping trouble code short name long name e.g. NL = lights, = Side . using year’s worth data October 2024 October 2025.

title: Data
text: cleaned Con Edison outage dataset standardizing date fields, correcting common formatting errors, enforcing chronological consistency across STARTDATE, RESTDATE, COMPDATE. Empty strings converted missing values prior parsing, mixed timestamp formats resolved using flexible parse_date_time() rules. outages incorrectly reported 2023 timestamps, restoration completion dates labeled 2023 shifted forward one year. Records missing critical fields COMPDATE TOTALCUSTAFFECTED removed. Categorical fields XBORO normalized uppercase support grouping visualization. resulting dataset tidy chronologically valid.

title: Data
text: preprocessing workflow, first removed rows missing COMPDATE TOTALCUSTAFFECTED. two fields essential: COMPDATE required compute outage duration, TOTALCUSTAFFECTED determines severity event. filtering critical cases, missing value analysis focuses UDF_MUNICIPALITY, TROUBLECODE, unknown borough entries (“-NDA-”) XBORO.   missingness isolated TROUBLECODE, observations missing multiple fields , indicating missingness sparse.

code: outages_boro <- outages |>   mutate(     start_ts = lubridate::ymd_hms(STARTDATE, tz = "UTC"),     rest_ts  = lubridate::ymd_hms(RESTDATE,  tz = "UTC"),          # Use start time as the "event day" for aggregation     outage_day = as.Date(start_ts),     duration_mins = as.numeric(difftime(rest_ts, start_ts, units = "mins"))   )  quartiles <- outages_boro |>   group_by(XBORO) |>   summarise(     Q1 = quantile(duration_mins, 0.25),     Median = median(duration_mins),     Q3 = quantile(duration_mins, 0.75),     .groups = "drop"   ) %>%   tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(Q1, Median, Q3),                       names_to = "stat",                       values_to = "y")  ggplot(outages_boro, aes(x = XBORO, y = duration_mins)) +   geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE) +   labs(title="Outage Duration by Borough",        x= "Borough",        y="Duration in Minutes") +   geom_text(     data = quartiles,     aes(x = XBORO, y = y, label = round(y, 2)),     vjust = -0.5,  # Adjust vertical position     color = "black",     size = 2   ) +   theme(     axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8)   )
